root_cause.text: The `vxlan_na_create` function in the VXLAN driver parses Neighbor Discovery (ND) options without validating that the option-provided length is within the bounds of the remaining option area or sufficient to contain an Ethernet address payload.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds bounds checks to the ND option parsing loop, specifically verifying that `i + (ns->opt[i + 1] << 3) > ns_olen` to prevent advancing beyond the option span, and checking that `(ns->opt[i + 1] << 3) >= sizeof(struct nd_opt_hdr) + ETH_ALEN` before reading the source link-layer address (`ND_OPT_SOURCE_LL_ADDR`).
